asset: CALM-MS conformal second-reader — V&V enablement gate
source: Converged conclusion of the 2026-08-21 adversarial design+refute workflow (2 lanes, 2 skeptics) + independent ground-truth verification. See VV-DOSSIER.md.
rationale: The conformal FDR/precision guarantee is valid ONLY within the single MSLesSeg exchangeable cohort and is undeliverable under real acquisition variation with the data on hand. The endpoint MUST stay dark. Enabling is permitted ONLY when every gate below is 'pass'.

gate_1_calibration_validity.summary: Distribution-free construction is correct: standard one-sided conformal p-values (PRDS) + Benjamini-Hochberg control MARGINAL lesion-wise FDR by theorem. Fail-closed matrix enforced + tested (non-finite refused, degenerate/empty null refused, contamination refused, grid/spacing mismatch refused).

gate_2_coverage_on_heldout.summary: SERVED raw mean-pooled statistic, MSLesSeg subject-LOSO (75 subjects / 115 scans, calib_overlap=0.0, null value-equivalent to the frozen 1174 scores). Marginal lesion-wise FDR <= alpha at all three presets (0.105/0.082/0.018), subject-clustered bootstrap 95% CI upper <= alpha. This is a CONSISTENCY CHECK confirming the Gate-1 theorem holds within-domain (no implementation bug + within-cohort exchangeability), NOT independent safety evidence. NOT cleared: (a) RECALL COLLAPSE - sensitivity 0.340/0.197/0.076 (median 0 at 0.20 and 0.10), selects NOTHING on 43/57/86 of 115 scans; FDR is partly controlled by near-empty selection (realized FDR up to ~5x below target = over-conservative, not well-calibrated). (b) per-scan FDP disperses: exceeds alpha on 12-13% of scans, 19-31% conditional on selecting. (c) any-voxel TP headline; under majority-overlap realized FDR rises (Probe A). Cross-site / OOD-blind confident-FP inflation RELOCATED to Gate 7. Recall-floor acceptance is an OPEN BLOCKING item at Gate 4/5 (HAZ-CALM-3/8); the additive design (base mask never suppressed) bounds the hazard to utility, not safety, but does NOT close it.
open_findings: per-scan FDP dispersion -> intrinsic to a marginal guarantee; usability disclosure (Gate 4)

gate_3_prior_art_differentiation.summary: Positioned honestly: controls lesion-wise FDR/PRECISION via conformal selection (Jin & Candes 2023) + BH — orthogonal to CLS (arXiv 2510.17897) which controls FNR/RECALL via CRC (Angelopoulos & Bates 2208.02814). The wrapper itself is NOT novel (conformal lesion-FDR exists for tumour/nodule); the defensible contribution is the cautionary characterization of MS acquisition-driven label-shift + a transparent within-domain scorer.

gate_4_usability_iec62366.summary: IEC 62366-1 summative usability study proving no reader mis-infers per-scan precision or per-lesion probability, and that low-tier (de-prioritized) true lesions are still reviewed (HAZ-CALM-2/3/8). Does not exist.

gate_5_change_control_pccp.summary: Per-preset clinical validation + an authorized Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP). Does not exist.

gate_6_base_model_bound_producer.summary: REQ-FUNC-CALM-007: a production probability-map producer that stamps base_model=FLAMeS + grid provenance the endpoint verifies. Today the map is bring-your-own (research); a non-FLAMeS map on the right grid is not caught. Does not exist.

gate_7_multisite_external_validation.summary: >=3-5 real acquisition sites, FLAMeS-independent, single geometry, ~20-30 labelled scans/scanner, with measured cross-site realized-FDR<=alpha per preset (and/or a validated Mondrian site-conditional calibration). Not meetable on public data; requires new acquisition.
